messaging.title: Bot messaging
messaging.subtitle: Configure the bot channels (Telegram, WhatsApp Cloud, Signal, Email-IMAP) through which users can book rooms via message.

telegram.help: Free conversational bot. Quick setup via @BotFather.
telegram.setup_guide:
1) Open @BotFather on Telegram → /newbot → get the token.
2) Save the token here (the webhook secret is generated automatically in the next step).
3) Click "Auto-configure": Cadenza registers the webhook, the command list (/help, /book, /list, /cancel, /check) and the description directly on Telegram. No curl, no @BotFather.

MANUAL FLOW (alternative):
1) openssl rand -hex 32 for the secret
2) curl -F "url=https://cadenza.example.it/api/messaging/telegram/webhook" -F "secret_token=SECRET" https://api.telegram.org/botTOKEN/setWebhook

auto.button_title: Generate secret + register webhook + set commands/description on Telegram

whatsapp.help: WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta direct). Requires verified Meta Business account.
whatsapp.setup_guide:
1) Create a Meta Business app + WhatsApp Business: https://developers.facebook.com/apps
2) Copy: Phone Number ID, System User access token (long-lived), App Secret.
3) Pick a random Verify Token and save it here.
4) Set callback URL: https://cadenza.example.it/api/messaging/whatsapp_cloud/webhook
   with the same Verify Token and subscribe to 'messages' events.

signal.help: Signal via signal-cli (community). Requires a host running signal-cli and a dedicated registered number.
signal.setup_guide:
1) Install signal-cli (https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli) on a reachable host.
2) Register a dedicated number and run:
   signal-cli daemon --http 0.0.0.0:8080
3) Configure a forwarder to relay incoming messages to the Cadenza webhook with header X-Signal-Webhook-Secret.

email.help: Always-on fallback via dedicated mailbox. Stub: IMAP poller will land in a future sprint.
email.setup_guide:
1) Create a dedicated mailbox (e.g. book@conservatorio.it).
2) Configure host/port/credentials here.
3) IMAP poller is not yet active: this channel remains a stub that does not receive messages (see roadmap).

isidata.preview_hint: Nothing has been changed yet. Changes will only be applied after explicit confirmation.

isidata.done_hint: See the history at the bottom of this page, under "Recent runs".

isidata.mapping_hint: Check that each Cadenza field is linked to the correct file header. Rows in "manual" state won't be touched by future auto-detections.
isidata.compare_subtitle: Differences against the previous "success" run of the same provider.
isidata.compare_empty: No previous run available for comparison.
isidata.compare_repeat_updates_hint: Users updated in the previous run too: could be typos in the source file — investigate.
